name: What are the common signs that my roof needs repair or replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my roof needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of roof issues include missing, cracked, or curled shingles, especially after a storm. You might also notice granules from shingles accumulating in your gutters, indicating wear. Inside your home, water spots on ceilings or walls, drafts, and higher energy bills can point to a compromised roof. It's important to address these early to prevent more extensive and costly damage to your home's structure. Regular inspections can help identify problems before they become severe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for damaged shingles, granules in gutters, water stains inside, or drafts. Higher energy bills can also indicate a problem.
